messages.name: ACQUISINATOR_RAW
messages.comment: Three consecutive raw ADC samples (amplifier output, CH0), oldest first.

signals.name: Debug_adcRaw0_U
signals.comment: Oldest raw ADC code (0..65535), not converted to volts.

signals.name: Debug_adcRaw1_U
signals.comment: Middle raw ADC code (0..65535), not converted to volts.

signals.name: Debug_adcRaw2_U
signals.comment: Newest raw ADC code (0..65535), not converted to volts.

signals.name: Debug_seq_U
signals.comment: Frame counter, wraps at 255: a gap means frames or samples were lost.

messages.name: ACQUISINATOR_LOCKIN
messages.comment: Lock-in result of the last demodulation window, in raw ADC counts (peak). Sent together with ACQUISINATOR_LOCKIN_STATUS.

signals.name: Lockin_inPhase
signals.comment: In-phase amplitude I = A*cos(phi) of the amplifier output at the excitation frequency, ADC counts (peak).

signals.name: Lockin_quadrature
signals.comment: Quadrature amplitude Q = A*sin(phi), ADC counts (peak).

messages.name: ACQUISINATOR_LOCKIN_STATUS
messages.comment: Statistics of the same window as ACQUISINATOR_LOCKIN, raw ADC counts.

signals.name: Lockin_dc_U
signals.comment: Mean amplifier output over the window, ADC counts.

signals.name: Lockin_min_U
signals.comment: Smallest sample in the window, ADC counts (clipping check).

signals.name: Lockin_max_U
signals.comment: Largest sample in the window, ADC counts (clipping check).

signals.name: Lockin_spiError_B
signals.comment: An SPI read failed since the previous result: the window was restarted.

signals.name: Lockin_seq_U
signals.comment: Result counter, wraps at 255: a gap means results were lost.
